observedMeaning: OSM documents posted advisory speeds separately from legally binding maxspeed, commonly on curves and ramps. Bare values use km/h; explicit mph is supported. Forward/backward suffixes distinguish travel directions.
prototypeInference: Cap the existing estimated driving speed at a valid unqualified posted advisory value. This is our static timing hypothesis, not a legal restriction, mandatory driver behavior, observed travel speed, or proof of ORS hosted behavior.

rule.bounds: existing source numeric parser, positive and at most160km/h
